title: Proxmox VE: server virtualisation with a web interface

videos.script: On a laptop, a hypervisor is an application you open. In a small company's server room, it is often the whole server, managed from a browser. {{server}} Proxmox VE is one of the most common ways to do that. It is free, it is Linux, and you install it on a server the way you install any operating system, from a USB stick. {{install}} Underneath, it runs the same QEMU and KVM this course has been using. What it adds is everything around them. A web page to create and watch machines, storage for their disks, backups, and a way to join several servers into one. {{adds}} This computer cannot run Proxmox itself. So you will look at the engine it shares with our lab, and at the pieces Proxmox gives names to. {{engine}}
